mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO
( student_id, gender, age, parental_education, family_income, internet_access, study_environment, study_hours_per_day, attendance_rate, sleep_hours, social_media_hours, assignment_completion_rate, participation_score, online_courses_completed, tutoring, math_score, reading_score, writing_score, science_score, final_exam_score, previous_gpa, pass_fail, grade_category ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{parentalEducation}, #{familyIncome}, #{internetAccess}, #{studyEnvironment}, #{studyHoursPerDay}, #{attendanceRate}, #{sleepHours}, #{socialMediaHours}, #{assignmentCompletionRate}, #{participationScore}, #{onlineCoursesCompleted}, #{tutoring}, #{mathScore}, #{readingScore}, #{writingScore}, #{scienceScore}, #{finalExamScore}, #{previousGpa}, #{passFail}, #{gradeCategory} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE
SET student_id = #{studentId}, gender = #{gender}, age = #{age}, parental_education = #{parentalEducation}, family_income = #{familyIncome}, internet_access = #{internetAccess}, study_environment = #{studyEnvironment}, study_hours_per_day = #{studyHoursPerDay}, attendance_rate = #{attendanceRate}, sleep_hours = #{sleepHours}, social_media_hours = #{socialMediaHours}, assignment_completion_rate = #{assignmentCompletionRate}, participation_score = #{participationScore}, online_courses_completed = #{onlineCoursesCompleted}, tutoring = #{tutoring}, math_score = #{mathScore}, reading_score = #{readingScore}, writing_score = #{writingScore}, science_score = #{scienceScore}, final_exam_score = #{finalExamScore}, previous_gpa = #{previousGpa}, pass_fail = #{passFail}, grade_category = #{gradeCategory} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT gender FROM WHERE gender IS NOT NULL AND gender != '' ORDER BY gender ASC
SELECT DISTINCT parental_education FROM WHERE parental_education IS NOT NULL AND parental_education != '' ORDER BY parental_education ASC
SELECT DISTINCT family_income FROM WHERE family_income IS NOT NULL AND family_income != '' ORDER BY family_income ASC
SELECT DISTINCT internet_access FROM WHERE internet_access IS NOT NULL AND internet_access != '' ORDER BY internet_access ASC
SELECT DISTINCT study_environment FROM WHERE study_environment IS NOT NULL AND study_environment != '' ORDER BY study_environment ASC
SELECT DISTINCT tutoring FROM WHERE tutoring IS NOT NULL AND tutoring != '' ORDER BY tutoring ASC
SELECT DISTINCT pass_fail FROM WHERE pass_fail IS NOT NULL AND pass_fail != '' ORDER BY pass_fail ASC
SELECT DISTINCT grade_category FROM WHERE grade_category IS NOT NULL AND grade_category != '' ORDER BY grade_category ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount, COUNT(DISTINCT gender) AS genderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT grade_category) AS gradeCategoryCount, ROUND(AVG(final_exam_score), 2) AS avgFinalScore, ROUND(AVG(math_score), 2) AS avgMathScore, ROUND(AVG(reading_score), 2) AS avgReadingScore, ROUND(AVG(writing_score), 2) AS avgWritingScore, ROUND(AVG(science_score), 2) AS avgScienceScore, ROUND(AVG(previous_gpa), 2) AS avgPreviousGpa, ROUND(AVG(study_hours_per_day), 2) AS avgStudyHours, ROUND(AVG(attendance_rate), 2) AS avgAttendanceRate, ROUND(AVG(sleep_hours), 2) AS avgSleepHours, ROUND(AVG(social_media_hours), 2) AS avgSocialMediaHours, ROUND(AVG(assignment_completion_rate), 2) AS avgAssignmentRate, ROUND(AVG(participation_score), 2) AS avgParticipationScore, ROUND(AVG(online_courses_completed), 2) AS avgOnlineCourses, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(pass_fail, '')) LIKE '%pass%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passCount, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(pass_fail, '')) LIKE '%fail%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(pass_fail, '')) LIKE '%pass%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0) * 100, 2) AS passRate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(tutoring, '')) IN ('yes', 'y', 'true', '1', '是') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0) * 100, 2) AS tutoringRate FROM

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(pass_fail, ''), '未知状态') AS labelName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(COUNT(1) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ), 0) * 100, 2) AS ratio, ROUND(AVG(final_exam_score), 2) AS avgFinalScore, ROUND(AVG(study_hours_per_day), 2) AS avgStudyHours FROM
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(pass_fail, ''), '未知状态') ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(grade_category, ''), '未知等级') AS labelName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(COUNT(1) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ), 0) * 100, 2) AS ratio, ROUND(AVG(final_exam_score), 2) AS avgFinalScore, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(pass_fail, '')) LIKE '%pass%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0) * 100, 2) AS passRate FROM
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(grade_category, ''), '未知等级') ORDER BY avgFinalScore DESC, totalCount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(gender, ''), '未知性别') AS labelName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(COUNT(1) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ), 0) * 100, 2) AS ratio, ROUND(AVG(final_exam_score), 2) AS avgFinalScore, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(pass_fail, '')) LIKE '%pass%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0) * 100, 2) AS passRate FROM
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(gender, ''), '未知性别') ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT '数学成绩' AS subjectName, ROUND(AVG(math_score), 2) AS avgScore, ROUND(MAX(math_score), 2) AS maxScore, ROUND(MIN(math_score), 2) AS minScore FROM UNION ALL SELECT '阅读成绩' AS subjectName, ROUND(AVG(reading_score), 2) AS avgScore, ROUND(MAX(reading_score), 2) AS maxScore, ROUND(MIN(reading_score), 2) AS minScore FROM UNION ALL SELECT '写作成绩' AS subjectName, ROUND(AVG(writing_score), 2) AS avgScore, ROUND(MAX(writing_score), 2) AS maxScore, ROUND(MIN(writing_score), 2) AS minScore FROM UNION ALL SELECT '科学成绩' AS subjectName, ROUND(AVG(science_score), 2) AS avgScore, ROUND(MAX(science_score), 2) AS maxScore, ROUND(MIN(science_score), 2) AS minScore FROM UNION ALL SELECT '期末成绩' AS subjectName, ROUND(AVG(final_exam_score), 2) AS avgScore, ROUND(MAX(final_exam_score), 2) AS maxScore, ROUND(MIN(final_exam_score), 2) AS minScore FROM

SELECT CASE WHEN age IS NULL THEN '未知年龄' WHEN age <= 12 THEN '12岁及以下' WHEN age BETWEEN 13 AND 15 THEN '13-15岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 16 AND 18 THEN '16-18岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 19 AND 22 THEN '19-22岁' ELSE '23岁及以上' END AS segmentName, CASE WHEN age IS NULL THEN 99 WHEN age <= 12 THEN 1 WHEN age BETWEEN 13 AND 15 THEN 2 WHEN age BETWEEN 16 AND 18 THEN 3 WHEN age BETWEEN 19 AND 22 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS sortNo, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(final_exam_score), 2) AS avgFinalScore, ROUND(AVG(study_hours_per_day), 2) AS avgStudyHours, ROUND(AVG(attendance_rate), 2) AS avgAttendanceRate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(pass_fail, '')) LIKE '%pass%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0) * 100, 2) AS passRate FROM
GROUP BY segmentName, sortNo ORDER BY sortNo ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN study_hours_per_day IS NULL THEN '未知时长' WHEN study_hours_per_day < 1 THEN '1小时以下' WHEN study_hours_per_day >= 1 AND study_hours_per_day < 2 THEN '1-2小时' WHEN study_hours_per_day >= 2 AND study_hours_per_day < 4 THEN '2-4小时' WHEN study_hours_per_day >= 4 AND study_hours_per_day < 6 THEN '4-6小时' ELSE '6小时及以上' END AS segmentName, CASE WHEN study_hours_per_day IS NULL THEN 99 WHEN study_hours_per_day < 1 THEN 1 WHEN study_hours_per_day >= 1 AND study_hours_per_day < 2 THEN 2 WHEN study_hours_per_day >= 2 AND study_hours_per_day < 4 THEN 3 WHEN study_hours_per_day >= 4 AND study_hours_per_day < 6 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS sortNo, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(final_exam_score), 2) AS avgFinalScore, ROUND(AVG(attendance_rate), 2) AS avgAttendanceRate, ROUND(AVG(assignment_completion_rate), 2) AS avgAssignmentRate, ROUND(AVG(social_media_hours), 2) AS avgSocialMediaHours, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(pass_fail, '')) LIKE '%pass%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0) * 100, 2) AS passRate FROM
GROUP BY segmentName, sortNo ORDER BY sortNo ASC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(family_income, ''), '未知收入') AS labelName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(final_exam_score), 2) AS avgFinalScore, ROUND(AVG(study_hours_per_day), 2) AS avgStudyHours, ROUND(AVG(attendance_rate), 2) AS avgAttendanceRate, ROUND(AVG(previous_gpa), 2) AS avgPreviousGpa, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(pass_fail, '')) LIKE '%pass%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0) * 100, 2) AS passRate FROM
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(family_income, ''), '未知收入') ORDER BY avgFinalScore DESC, totalCount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(parental_education, ''), '未知教育') AS labelName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(final_exam_score), 2) AS avgFinalScore, ROUND(AVG(study_hours_per_day), 2) AS avgStudyHours, ROUND(AVG(attendance_rate), 2) AS avgAttendanceRate, ROUND(AVG(previous_gpa), 2) AS avgPreviousGpa, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(pass_fail, '')) LIKE '%pass%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0) * 100, 2) AS passRate FROM
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(parental_education, ''), '未知教育') ORDER BY avgFinalScore DESC, totalCount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(internet_access, ''), '未知网络') AS labelName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(final_exam_score), 2) AS avgFinalScore, ROUND(AVG(online_courses_completed), 2) AS avgOnlineCourses, ROUND(AVG(assignment_completion_rate), 2) AS avgAssignmentRate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(pass_fail, '')) LIKE '%pass%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0) * 100, 2) AS passRate FROM
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(internet_access, ''), '未知网络') ORDER BY avgFinalScore DESC, totalCount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(study_environment, ''), '未知环境') AS labelName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(final_exam_score), 2) AS avgFinalScore, ROUND(AVG(study_hours_per_day), 2) AS avgStudyHours, ROUND(AVG(attendance_rate), 2) AS avgAttendanceRate, ROUND(AVG(assignment_completion_rate), 2) AS avgAssignmentRate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(pass_fail, '')) LIKE '%pass%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0) * 100, 2) AS passRate FROM
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(study_environment, ''), '未知环境') ORDER BY avgFinalScore DESC, totalCount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(grade_category, ''), '未知等级') AS gradeCategory, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(math_score), 2) AS avgMathScore, ROUND(AVG(reading_score), 2) AS avgReadingScore, ROUND(AVG(writing_score), 2) AS avgWritingScore, ROUND(AVG(science_score), 2) AS avgScienceScore, ROUND(AVG(final_exam_score), 2) AS avgFinalScore, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(pass_fail, '')) LIKE '%pass%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0) * 100, 2) AS passRate FROM
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(grade_category, ''), '未知等级') ORDER BY avgFinalScore DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(pass_fail, ''), '未知状态') AS labelName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(study_hours_per_day), 2) AS avgStudyHours, ROUND(AVG(attendance_rate), 2) AS avgAttendanceRate, ROUND(AVG(sleep_hours), 2) AS avgSleepHours, ROUND(AVG(social_media_hours), 2) AS avgSocialMediaHours, ROUND(AVG(assignment_completion_rate), 2) AS avgAssignmentRate, ROUND(AVG(participation_score), 2) AS avgParticipationScore, ROUND(AVG(online_courses_completed), 2) AS avgOnlineCourses, ROUND(AVG(final_exam_score), 2) AS avgFinalScore FROM
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(pass_fail, ''), '未知状态') ORDER BY avgFinalScore DESC

SELECT student_id AS studentId, study_hours_per_day AS studyHoursPerDay, attendance_rate AS attendanceRate, assignment_completion_rate AS assignmentCompletionRate, social_media_hours AS socialMediaHours, sleep_hours AS sleepHours, final_exam_score AS finalExamScore, pass_fail AS passFail, grade_category AS gradeCategory FROM
AND study_hours_per_day IS NOT NULL AND final_exam_score IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1200

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(grade_category, ''), '未知等级') AS gradeCategory, CASE WHEN study_hours_per_day IS NULL THEN '未知时长' WHEN study_hours_per_day < 1 THEN '1小时以下' WHEN study_hours_per_day >= 1 AND study_hours_per_day < 2 THEN '1-2小时' WHEN study_hours_per_day >= 2 AND study_hours_per_day < 4 THEN '2-4小时' WHEN study_hours_per_day >= 4 AND study_hours_per_day < 6 THEN '4-6小时' ELSE '6小时及以上' END AS studyHourSegment, CASE WHEN study_hours_per_day IS NULL THEN 99 WHEN study_hours_per_day < 1 THEN 1 WHEN study_hours_per_day >= 1 AND study_hours_per_day < 2 THEN 2 WHEN study_hours_per_day >= 2 AND study_hours_per_day < 4 THEN 3 WHEN study_hours_per_day >= 4 AND study_hours_per_day < 6 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS sortNo, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(final_exam_score), 2) AS avgFinalScore FROM
GROUP BY gradeCategory, studyHourSegment, sortNo ORDER BY sortNo ASC, gradeCategory ASC
